verification_policy: Batched readability workflow: exact token substitution for alpha-only edits; review event routing, callback order and live/cached reads for structured edits. One target build per batch. Native comparisons reserved for uncertain behavior; reccmp refresh deferred to a larger checkpoint.
scope: Readability reconstruction of existing Aether Revolt card handlers and local helpers. No new native-function coverage or gameplay-equivalence claim. Preserve unusual native behavior, repeated context checks and opaque dialogs.
review_notes: Aura and spell gates retain accepted event sets, affected-card qualification, humiliation checks, target defaults and rechecks after callbacks.
Keep Ajani deck iteration/removal quirks, target/payment ordering, target-slot swaps, live target counts, temporary target marks and cleanup on cancellation.
Keep upkeep current-turn snapshots, duplicate legacy detection, death aggregation, detach flags, low-byte result counts and repeated status/context queries.
Keep Walking Ballista payment-success count separate from failure reloads; Ice Over and native mana/vehicle/energy dialog behavior remain unchanged.
Replace Ironclad prompt copy with an identical 100-byte initialized array and Dockhand alignment-specific zeroing with an identical 302-byte zeroed array.
Nineteen alpha-only definitions retain exact tokens after declared renames. Thirty-nine structured definitions receive source review and batched builds, with no native semantic-equivalence claim.
Pia preserves packed death-card bytes, legacy/card storage ranges, reverse resolution, cached graveyard pointers, opponent payment/target checks and damage-versus-return behavior.
Scrap Trawler preserves cached records, detach flags, capacity/duplicate count queries, the release's unusual store/resolve slot offsets and tutor ordering.
Archangel preserves both damage passes and their player lookup, live turn refresh between passes, independent loss flags, draw suppression and EVENT_TRIGGER side effects.
Unbridled Growth preserves attached-land checks, mana/sacrifice eligibility, payment/dispatch order, and its aura/cast/retarget behavior.

Creativity and Gremlins preserve target defaults, cast-context rechecks, retarget preview dialogs and chooser changes, free/token paths, distinct human/AI X costs, cancellation exits and target unmarking.

Improvise preserves fixed-cost versus X-contribution payment routes, selection marks, fresh fizzle reads during cleanup, normal-cast handling and success return values. Opaque dialogs remain out of scope.
status: All 58 Aether Revolt definitions applied. Final target build and updated coverage receipt follow; reccmp refresh remains deferred.
